concerns.text: FR-001 (ENCODE download), FR-003 (zero-expression filter), FR-005 (median imputation), and FR-010 (performance gap) lack viable implementation tasks. T010, T013, T014, and T016b are marked with 'FAILED' or 'unspecified' comments and have no active, working replacement task defined to satisfy these functional requirements.

Spec SC-001 (Interpretability) and SC-004 (Reproducibility) require documentation of limitations, but tasks T047, T060-T065 and T048, T050, T057-T059 are duplicate entries for the same deliverables (e.g., 'Dappled Models', 'Correlation vs. Causation'). This redundancy obscures the actual coverage of the requirement and creates conflicting implementation paths.

Plan 'Constitution Check' item 1 mandates a deterministic synthetic data generator to satisfy Reproducibility. Task T005 defines this generator, but the Analyze Report indicates T011 (execution of T005) has failed verification. There is no active task to 'Fix Synthetic Data Generator' to restore the foundational data source required for all downstream FRs.

Tasks T060-T065 and T048, T050, T057-T059 are stale duplicates referencing the same 'Freeman-Dyson' review feedback. T060 and T048 both target 'Dappled Models'; T050 and T057 both target 'Correlation vs. Causation'; T058 and T064 both target 'Causality Warning' headers. These should be consolidated into single, unique task IDs to avoid confusion.
